newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt considering offering shares in media city.
newsitem.headline: Egypt considering offering shares in media city.

text.p: Egypt is considering offering to the public soon about 30 percent of its holdings in a $300 million television production complex, the information minister was quoted on Tuesday as saying.

The goverment daily al-Ahram quoted Safwat el-Sherif as saying the state would keep about 70 percent of the Mubarak Media City and that state-owned National Bank of Egypt would find a way to sell the remaining shares within weeks.
Last month, a British-based consortium including Sony Broadcast and Professional and Kvaerner Construction won a $300 million contract to build the complex.
The television studios are part of a massive project dubbed "Hollywood on the Nile" in Sixth of October City, a satellite city in the desert 30 km (20 miles) west of Cairo.
